mutations.obligation: SATB requires a tenor array
SATB soprano must stay in certified register
Contract version must equal the supported version
Soprano events use channel zero
Boolean is not an integer degree
music must be an object
Bass pitch must be >= the independently fixed bass_low
First rhythm event cannot be a tie without a sounding predecessor
Actual target-bearing harmony requires its local target identity
Borrowed source must be the canonical parallel source in the active key
Key contexts must change at the externally declared boundary
Displayed chord form must match reconstruction
Verified rule claims must match freshly evaluated rules
Composition digest must equal independent reconstruction
Objective metadata must equal recomputation
Embedded request cannot replace the externally fixed seed; all embedded hashes are coordinated
Tenor track must be present
Voice tracks must be unique
Initial key event must match request; choose a different key
SMF tick division must equal 480
Melody onset tick must equal its projected onset
Certified rest interval must contain no extra note
Tied melody event must span all tied steps

uncertainty.method: Wilson 95% interval on all-detected fixture clusters
uncertainty.assumption: Illustrative independent fixture Bernoulli sampling; fixed purposive corpus is not a random population sample

stopping_rule: One attempt per fixed request, all slots retained, no replacement or adaptive early stop
correction_policy: Changes informed by held-out faults require a documented deviation, version change and fresh held-out set
exclusions: No planned exclusions; eligibility failures are NOT_APPLICABLE and generation failures retain all slots
